# Plan: Unified Wiki Reader + Backend Integration Fixes

## Part A: UX Redesign — Unified Wiki Reader

### Context

Live E2E testing exposed two problems: (1) backend gaps producing garbage data, and (2) a fragmented frontend with 6+ separate page routes for wiki content that should be one continuous reading experience.

The user proposed: **module.html IS the wiki**. One 3-column layout (sidebar nav, content area, TOC) where sidebar sections replace separate pages entirely. This matches how Stripe Docs, Tailwind, and Mintlify work.

### Mock Cleanup — `specs/001-code-wiki/ux/docs-glassmorphism/`

**Current**: 15 HTML mocks + README (16 files)

**REMOVE** (absorbed into module.html's sidebar sections):

| File | Why remove | Becomes |
|------|-----------|---------|
| `home.html` | Replaced by "Overview" sidebar section | First content section in wiki reader |
| `getting-started.html` | Replaced by "Getting Started" sidebar group | Sidebar: Quick Start, Installation |
| `glossary.html` | Replaced by "Reference > Glossary" sidebar item | Sidebar section |
| `api-reference.html` | Replaced by "Reference > API" sidebar item | Sidebar section |
| `diagrams.html` | Replaced by "Architecture > Diagrams" sidebar item | Sidebar section |
| `index.html` | Navigation hub for mocks only — not a real app page | Delete entirely |

**KEEP** (9 files — distinct app pages with their own layouts):

| File | Role | Layout |
|------|------|--------|
| `module.html` | **THE wiki reader** — all wiki content lives here | 3-column: sidebar + content + TOC |
| `function.html` | Entity detail drill-down (from wiki links) | Same 3-column, deeper context |
| `search.html` | Full-text search across wiki | Dedicated search layout |
| `chat.html` | AI chat assistant | Dedicated chat layout |
| `dashboard.html` | Repository list management | App chrome |
| `submit.html` | Add repository form | App chrome |
| `progress.html` | Analysis pipeline status | App chrome |
| `login.html` | Authentication | App chrome |
| `error.html` | Error states (404, failure) | App chrome |

**Action**: Delete 6 HTML files + `index.html`. Update `README.md` to reflect 9 remaining mocks.

### Frontend Route Simplification

**Before** (current routes):
```
/[owner]/[name]                    → page.tsx (wiki home — separate page)
/[owner]/[name]/modules/[slug]     → modules/[slug]/page.tsx (module page)
/[owner]/[name]/modules            → redirects to wiki home
/[owner]/[name]/getting-started    → (if exists)
/[owner]/[name]/glossary           → (if exists)
/[owner]/[name]/api-reference      → (if exists)
```

**After** (unified):
```
/[owner]/[name]                    → Unified wiki reader (module.html layout)
/[owner]/[name]/[slug]             → Same reader, different sidebar section active
```

One layout component. Sidebar drives content. No separate page routes for wiki sections.

---

## Part B: Backend Integration Fixes

### Context

The **3-layer architecture is correctly implemented**: Layer 0 (RepoRecon), Layer 1 (19 agents), Layer 2 (3-agent wiki pipeline), Dossier blackboard, TAG_TRIGGERS — all work per plan.md. Failures are at **integration seams**.

### The Precise Divergence Point

CLAUDE.md defines `ArchitectureAnalyzer` as a **heuristic** agent: "module/layer structure from directories and imports". plan.md Agent Catalog (line 158) renames it to `ArchitecturalClassifier` as a **single-pass LLM** agent: "system style, design patterns" — a completely different output. Module detection capability lost. The ad-hoc `_detect_modules` in `analyze.py` (using `parts[0]`) was gap-filling code.

### All Gaps

| # | Expected | Actual | Fix |
|---|----------|--------|-----|
| **G1** | Module detection from dirs + imports | Naive `parts[0]` grouping | Adaptive-depth detection using source roots |
| **G2** | RepoFingerprint has project identity | Missing project_name, source_roots, build_output_dirs | Add 5 fields to fingerprint |
| **G3** | Deterministic extraction filters artifacts | 12,641 entities (mostly minified garbage) | Minified file detection in extractor |
| **G4** | Frontend reads API data | Hardcoded: classCount=28, description="AI-powered..." | Wire to wiki page API |
| **G5** | Entity paths repo-relative | Absolute cache paths in DB | Path conversion at persist time |

### Fix 1: Enhance RepoFingerprint

**Files**: `backend/src/recon/fingerprint.py`, `backend/src/recon/repo_recon.py`

Add to `RepoFingerprint`:
```python
project_name: str = ""
project_description: str = ""
source_roots: tuple[str, ...] = ()
build_output_dirs: tuple[str, ...] = ()
entry_points: tuple[str, ...] = ()
```

New deterministic functions: `_extract_project_metadata()`, `_detect_source_roots()`, `_detect_build_outputs()`

### Fix 2: Build Artifact Filtering

**Files**: `backend/src/parsers/extractor.py`, `backend/src/jobs/analyze.py`

`_is_build_artifact()`: path in build_output_dirs, `.js`/`.cjs`/`.mjs` avg line >300 chars, 0-newline files >10KB.

### Fix 3: Deterministic Module Detection

**File**: `backend/src/jobs/analyze.py` — replace `_detect_modules`

Adaptive depth: inside source roots → depth 2 (`src/hooks` → "hooks"); outside → depth 1. Merge tiny modules (<3 entities), split mega-modules (>40%), skip build_output_dirs.

### Fix 4: Wire Frontend to API Data

Replaced by Part A — unified wiki reader fetches all content from API. No hardcoded values.

### Fix 5: Repo-Relative Entity Paths

**File**: `backend/src/jobs/analyze.py` — `_persist_modules_and_entities`

Convert `entity.file_path` to relative using `Path.relative_to(local_path)` at persist time.

## Execution Order

1. **Mock cleanup** — delete 6+1 files from `docs-glassmorphism/`, update README
2. **Fix 1** — RepoFingerprint enhancement
3. **Fix 2** — Build artifact filtering
4. **Fix 3** — Module detection rewrite
5. **Fix 5** — Entity path conversion
6. **Fix 4** — Unified wiki reader frontend (uses module.html as blueprint)

## Verification

1. `repo_recon.run()` on claude-mem → `project_name`, `source_roots=("src",)`, `build_output_dirs` populated
2. `extract_entities()` → entity count drops from ~12k to ~800
3. Module detection → depth 2 inside `src/` → hooks, worker, sqlite, cli, viewer. No "src" mega-module
4. Frontend: one wiki reader layout, sidebar navigation, all content from API
5. Full re-run: clean DB → enqueue → end-to-end verify

   - Outside source roots: depth 1 → `installer`, `tests`, `scripts`

   - Merge tiny modules (<3 entities, no index file) into parent
   - Split mega-modules (>40% of total entities) to depth 3
   - Skip modules entirely inside `build_output_dirs`
4. Strip source root prefix from names: `src/hooks` → "hooks"

This is CLAUDE.md's "Directory Structure (Primary)" auto-generation strategy, enhanced with source-root awareness. Import/call graph clustering (strategy 2) deferred.

**File**: `backend/src/jobs/analyze.py` — `_persist_modules_and_entities`

```python
try:
    rel_path = str(Path(entity.file_path).resolve().relative_to(local_path))
except ValueError:
    rel_path = entity.file_path
db_entity = CodeEntityModel(file_path=rel_path, ...)
```

# Plan: Unified Wiki Reader + Backend Integration Fixes

## Part A: UX Redesign — Unified Wiki Reader

### Context

Live E2E testing exposed two problems: (1) backend gaps producing garbage data, and (2) a fragmented frontend with 6+ separate page routes for wiki content that should be one continuous reading experience.

The user proposed: **module.html IS the wiki**. One 3-column layout (sidebar nav, content area, TOC) where sidebar sections replace separate pages entirely. This matches how Stripe Docs, Tailwind, and Mintlify work.

### Mock Cleanup — `specs/001-code-wiki/ux/docs-glassmorphism/`

**Current**: 15 HTML mocks + README (16 files)

**REMOVE** (absorbed into module.html's sidebar sections):

| File | Why remove | Becomes |
|------|-----------|---------|
| `home.html` | Replaced by "Overview" sidebar section | First content section in wiki reader |
| `getting-started.html` | Replaced by "Getting Started" sidebar group | Sidebar: Quick Start, Installation |
| `glossary.html` | Replaced by "Reference > Glossary" sidebar item | Sidebar section |
| `api-reference.html` | Replaced by "Reference > API" sidebar item | Sidebar section |
| `diagrams.html` | Replaced by "Architecture > Diagrams" sidebar item | Sidebar section |
| `index.html` | Navigation hub for mocks only — not a real app page | Delete entirely |

**KEEP** (9 files — distinct app pages with their own layouts):

| File | Role | Layout |
|------|------|--------|
| `module.html` | **THE wiki reader** — all wiki content lives here | 3-column: sidebar + content + TOC |
| `function.html` | Entity detail drill-down (from wiki links) | Same 3-column, deeper context |
| `search.html` | Full-text search across wiki | Dedicated search layout |
| `chat.html` | AI chat assistant | Dedicated chat layout |
| `dashboard.html` | Repository list management | App chrome |
| `submit.html` | Add repository form | App chrome |
| `progress.html` | Analysis pipeline status | App chrome |
| `login.html` | Authentication | App chrome |
| `error.html` | Error states (404, failure) | App chrome |

**Action**: Delete 6 HTML files + `index.html`. Update `README.md` to reflect 9 remaining mocks.

### Frontend Route Simplification

**Before** (current routes):
```
/[owner]/[name]                    → page.tsx (wiki home — separate page)
/[owner]/[name]/modules/[slug]     → modules/[slug]/page.tsx (module page)

One layout component. Sidebar drives content. No separate page routes for wiki sections.

---

## Part B: Backend Integration Fixes

### Context

The **3-layer architecture is correctly implemented**: Layer 0 (RepoRecon), Layer 1 (19 agents), Layer 2 (3-agent wiki pipeline), Dossier blackboard, TAG_TRIGGERS — all work per plan.md. Failures are at **integration seams**.

### The Precise Divergence Point

**Files**: `backend/src/recon/fingerprint.py`, `backend/src/recon/repo_recon.py`

```python
